notablePrerequisites:
Fire Whip attached to Felhide Spiritbender.
Felhide Spiritbender does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Felhide Spiritbender triggers, holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbender trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
The token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 5.
